en: A black‑and‑white wartime postcard showing a fortified hill with stone walls and a large round tower on top, overlooking a rocky slope with a few small buildings. The style is early 20th century. French printed captions at the bottom reference the First World War and identify the view as the Ciceron (Cicéron) Tower at Salonique (Salonica). There is a handwritten note in French at the top and a small printer's mark at the bottom.
